BiblicalUsage: Mneme is remembrance — Peter's promise that he will take care, even after his death, that his readers will always be able to call these things to mind.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Peter's last care is a pastor's care: truth that stays put after the teacher is gone.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
